content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the RITES Various Posts Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 04-10-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of RITES to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for RITES Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application for RITES recruitment is 04 October 2026. Ensure your application is submitted well before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Individual Consultant posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies for the Individual Consultant positions, including Used Water Expert, Standard & Specification Expert, and Procurement Specialist.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for these posts?
faq.answer: The educational qualifications vary by post but generally include a B.E./B.Tech/B.Sc in relevant engineering fields, along with a Master's degree or MBA/PG in Management. PhD is preferred for some roles.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for applying to RITES Individual Consultant roles?
faq.answer: The age limit for all Individual Consultant positions is not exceeding 60 years as of the application deadline.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Individual Consultant positions?
faq.answer: The salary ranges from Rs. 1,60,000/- to Rs. 2,00,000/- per month, depending on the specific post and the candidate's experience.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for RITES recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category of candidates applying for these RITES recruitment posts.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for RITES Individual Consultant jobs?
faq.answer: The selection process involves a document scrutiny/verification process followed by a personal interview. Candidates must clear both stages to be considered.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for these positions?
faq.answer: These positions are offered on a contract basis. Candidates will be engaged as Individual Consultants for a specific period as per the contract terms.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official RITES recruitment notification?
faq.answer: The official RITES recruitment notification can be accessed through the 'Important Links' section of this article, under the 'Official Notification PDF' link.

faq.question: Q10. Can candidates from any part of India apply?
faq.answer: Yes, the job location is listed as 'Across India', and the application process is online, making it accessible to candidates nationwide. The RITES office is located in Gurgaon.
